events.text: In its 2025 sustainability report, KLK reported completing product carbon footprint calculations for 171 product groups, exceeding the target of 50.
In its 2025 sustainability report, KLK reported achieving 97% traceability to plantations for refineries and kernel crushing plants.
In its 2024 sustainability report, KLK reported reducing Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas emissions intensity by 21% compared to the 2019 baseline.
In its 2024 sustainability report, KLK reported achieving 96% traceability to plantations for refineries and 97% traceability to mills.
KLK aims for a 25% reduction in greenhouse gas emission intensity by 2029/2030 (compared to 2018/2019) and net zero emissions by 2050.

The Industrial Court upheld Kuala Lumpur Kepong Bhd's decision to sack palm fruit calculator B Inthiran over assault of a foreign worker, calling it a 'necessary and proportionate response' to a serious breach of workplace discipline.
